# 2 Baruch Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**4:1** And the-LORD said to-me: "This-city shall-be-delivered-up for-a-season, and the-people shall-be-chastened for-a-season, and the-world shall-not-be-forgotten.

**4:2** Do-you-think that-this is-the-city of-which I-said: 'Upon the-palms-of-my-hands have-I-engraved-you'? Not-this-building that-is-now-in-your-midst is-the-[true-one]; this-is-[only] that-which-shall-be-revealed with-me, that-which-was-prepared beforehand here-from-the-time I-took-counsel to-make-Paradise.

**4:3** And I-showed-it to-Adam before-he-sinned; but-when-he-transgressed the-commandment, it-was-removed from-him, as-also Paradise.

**4:4** And after-these-things I-showed-it to-my-servant Abraham in-the-night-between the-portions-of-the-sacrifices.

**4:5** And again-also I-showed-it to-Moses on-Mount-Sinai when-I-showed-him the-likeness-of-the-tabernacle and-all-its-vessels.

**4:6** And-now, behold it-is-preserved with-me, as-also Paradise, and-shall-be-revealed with-me and-shall-come-to-pass at-that-hour that-my-Anointed-One begins-to-be-revealed.

**4:7** Therefore be-not-dismayed regarding-this: for what-now-is-happening comes-not-by-your-sin but-is-preparation for-what-is-to-come."

---

*EMET notes: The heavenly Jerusalem tradition is pivotal here. "Anointed One" = Messiah. The chain of revelations (Adam, Abraham, Moses) establishes continuity. "Palms of my hands" quotes Isa 49:16.*
